highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands paint, image filter, and overdraw APIs.
highlights_body: It also restores fast small-sigma raster blurs, streamlines repeated surface canvas access, and refreshes HarfBuzz shaping. This release removes deprecated notebook integration and promotes remaining pre-v4 obsoletes to compile errors, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors
breaking.body: Legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors, run-buffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality can no longer be used. Move to the constructors without sampleCount, the Glyphs or Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality are also absent from the v4 reference assembly.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive integration is no longer included
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp NuGet package no longer embeds the deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension. Consumers of .NET Interactive or Polyglot Notebooks must remove that integration or maintain an alternative renderer.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while preserving PDF support on Tizen and compatibility across Windows, WebAssembly, and Direct3D builds.
Includes the upstream m150 fix for a data race when shared CoreText-backed typefaces open or reuse font streams.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() to compute conservative paint bounds, including strokes, path effects, mask filters, and image filters, before calling SKCanvas.QuickReject().
Adds SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() overloads that turn SKOverdrawCanvas counts into a six-color heat map for rendering diagnostics.

bullets.lead: Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes
bullets.detail: Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() with tile-mode and input-filter overloads, plus SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty() for explicit transparent-black nodes.

bullets.lead: Small raster blurs are fast again
bullets.detail: Routes small-sigma CPU blurs away from the slow raster-pipeline path, restoring the dedicated box-approximation implementation across native platforms.
SKSurface.Canvas now reuses its managed wrapper across calls and recreates it only if the surface-owned wrapper was explicitly disposed.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Pre-v4 obsolete API migration, faster repeated SKSurface.Canvas access, and the small-sigma raster blur fix

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update and cross-platform native build compatibility.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.summary: Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsoletes to compile errors, removes deprecated .NET Interactive integration, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds paint fast bounds, overdraw visualization, crop and empty image filters, while fixing raster blur and surface canvas performance.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with AAT, Arabic fallback shaping, COLR v1, glyph-extents, and subsetting fixes.
